## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/gov-copy/ for the Foundation slice: USWDS forms copy, GOV.UK error/form/Service Manual patterns, VA.gov Content Style Guide. Update _index.yaml and docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] gov-copy/ directory created with YAML files for 3 source partitions:
  - USWDS forms copy (form labels, helper text, error messages, button labels, placeholder text) — license: CC0-1.0
  - GOV.UK error/form patterns and Service Manual writing-for-user-interfaces guidance — license: OGL-v3
  - VA.gov Content Style Guide (error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation, writing principles) — license: CC0-1.0 (va.gov is open)
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id (unique, stable), prior_art (source URL), precedence, domain: gov-copy, license
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated per entry
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all gov-copy/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns >=1 result for 'form error message' in gov-copy domain
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new gov-copy Foundation entries
- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml updated with: USWDS (CC0), GOV.UK Design System (OGL-v3), VA.gov Design System (CC0)
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_gov_copy_foundation.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: >=3 partitions with domain:gov-copy, rule_id, prior_art, precedence, Summary+Detail
- DD2: VA.gov entries cover error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation, writing principles
- DD3: GOV.UK entries cover error-summary, inline error, copy standards, Service Manual writing
- DD4: USWDS entries cover form labels, helper text, error standards, button labels, placeholder
- DD5: Schema valid + _index.yaml updated
- DD6: ref-query returns results
